lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 21 — On to Jerusalem / Paul Arrested

questions.questionText: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to where?
We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, sighted Cyprus, passed to the south of it, and landed at where?
We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them how many days?
Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go where?
When it was time to leave, all of them including wives and children accompanied us out of the city. What did they do on the beach?
We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at where, where we greeted the brothers and stayed a day?
Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of whom?
options: Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven

questions.questionText: How many unmarried daughters did Philip have who prophesied?
I came down from Judea and took Paul’s belt, bound my own hands and feet. Who am I?
Agabus said the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and hand him over to whom?
When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go. What did Paul say?
options: Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound but also to die in Jerusalem
I will go to Rome at once instead

questions.questionText: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said what?
After this we started on our way up to where?
Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason. Where was he from?
When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us how?
The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see whom?
options: James, and all the elders were present

questions.questionText: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles. What did they do?
options: They sent him away at once

questions.questionText: The elders said many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law. They have been informed that Paul teaches Jews to turn away from whom?
They advised Paul to join four men who have a vow and pay their expenses so all will know he lives in obedience to the law. What about Gentile believers?
options: We have written to them our decision (the letter from the council)
They must all be circumcised now
They must come to Jerusalem at once

questions.questionText: The next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. When the seven days were nearly over, whom saw him in the temple?
options: Some Jews from the province of Asia

questions.questionText: They shouted, Fellow Israelites, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and our law and this place. They said he brought whom into the temple?
options: Romans only named as soldiers later

questions.questionText: They had previously seen me in the city with Paul and assumed Paul had brought me into the temple. I am from Ephesus. Who am I?
The whole city was aroused. They seized Paul and dragged him from the temple, and immediately the gates were what?
While they were trying to kill him, news reached whom?
options: The commander of the Roman troops

questions.questionText: He at once took some officers and soldiers and ran down to the crowd. When the rioters saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped what?
The commander arrested him and ordered him to be bound with what?
The commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, so he ordered Paul to be taken into where?
When Paul reached the steps, the violence of the mob was so great he had to be carried by the soldiers. The crowd kept shouting what?
As Paul was about to be taken in, he asked the commander, May I say something to you? In what language?
options: Only Hebrew first to the commander

questions.questionText: The commander asked, Aren’t you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists into the wilderness? What did Paul say?
options: I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city

questions.questionText: Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. When they were silent he spoke to them in what language?
True or false: Paul was ready to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
options: True — but he never said it

questions.questionText: I am an early disciple from Cyprus who hosted the group. Who am I?
I am one of the Seven and I live in Caesarea. Who am I?
How many men with a vow did the elders ask Paul to join?
True or false: The commander thought Paul was an Egyptian rebel.
Paul said he was a citizen of which city?
Who bound his own hands and feet with Paul’s belt?
After the beach prayer at Tyre they boarded the ship and the disciples returned how?
True or false: Paul asked the commander for permission to speak to the people.
options: True — but in Latin only to the crowd

questions.questionText: From Miletus they sailed and landed at Tyre, because the ship was to unload its cargo there. How long did they stay?
Through the Spirit, the disciples at Tyre urged Paul not to go where?
They continued on to Ptolemais and greeted the brothers. How long did they stay?
At Caesarea they stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist. How many unmarried daughters did Philip have?
Who came down from Judea and prophesied by taking Paul’s belt?
James and the elders told Paul that many thousands of Jews had believed and were zealous for what?
The commander ordered Paul to be taken into the barracks. What did the soldiers have to do because of the violence of the crowd?
options: Send him to Rome that hour
